summary: Corrected WP-P2 Default Vector Retrieval and Readiness supersedes the temporary WP-P1 coding handoff because WP-P1 was accepted and delivered in commit 29e5937, while corrected intent commits b242a07538f0be908f72fbeda1a7dc017154535b and 6f0d1e04bb31c5bb23272501d6afdeb573af11f9 authorize the next seven-element slice. Coding must replace the synthetic default uninjected MCP semantic path with complete directly attributed approved-source reads, persistent ordered fail-closed readiness, one qualified query embedding, exact named-index parameterized Neo4j vector queries with expanding top-k through independent exhaustion even for all-zero results, and exact deterministic policy/direction, endpoint, complete View, unique per-object provenance, and canonical/content/index completion. WP-P1 remains frozen; SP-05/WP-P3, production cleanup, CLI/docs/release work, and manual deliveryStatus edits remain excluded.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Invoke typed implementation-design and unrelated semantic queries through getSystemArchitecture with no caller/Harness semantic retrieval or runtime dependency argument while the module-owned callback composition supplies exactly raw source behavior, filesystem/git/ACL metadata adapters, provider transport, and Neo4j driver operations. Exercise approved process resolution plus missing, unsafe-file, conflicting, legacy-alias, test/default, and fallback sources, aligned multi-window persistent records, and graph-tidy bypass.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Prohibited sources reject before readiness/provider/vector effects; the approved path directly reads and attributes every required key before readiness, performs one exact qwen3.7-text-embedding 1024-dimensional request, and sends that raw vector unchanged to exact argo_production_semantic_element_vector, argo_production_semantic_relationship_vector, and argo_production_semantic_view_vector parameterized db.index.vector.queryNodes calls. Expanding top-k follows correlated raw continuation to independent exhaustion, while an all-zero result still proves readiness, embedding, and one exhausted sequence per channel. Closure binds exact seed IDs to w5.implementation-design.v1 and declared ArchiMate direction, returns endpoint objects/versions and the complete selected View metadata, viewpoint, parent, ordered versioned members and relationship endpoints while excluding overlap cascade, provides unique first-inclusion provenance for every returned object, preserves canonical/content/index versions, and keeps graph-tidy an exact snapshot.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Invoke the same shipped default uninjected MCP path against exact raw persistent readiness records for structural-only SemanticIndexPending, missing View partial state, stale canonical version, failed, unknown, ArchitectureRelationship content-version mismatch, View index-version mismatch, and complete alignment, then invoke no-argument and graph-tidy controls.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: One total ledger proves approved credential reads precede readiness, readiness precedes provider, and provider precedes vector windows. Every non-aligned request rejects at the readiness event with SEMANTIC_INDEX_NOT_ALIGNED, exact fixture state, canonical/content/index versions, exact missing and mismatched channels, and fullSnapshotFallback:false; only complete alignment continues; no-argument and graph-tidy remain exact snapshots.

tasks.title: Implement persistent readiness and vector retrieval module
tasks.objective: Create one deep default retrieval module that owns fail-closed persistent readiness, qualified external query embedding, and three independent threshold-all Neo4j Vector Index channels.
steps: Implement createDefaultSemanticRetrieval(dependencies).retrieve(request) with approved external configuration and exact qwen3.7-text-embedding qualification at 1024 dimensions.

Implement module-owned callback-scoped composition with exactly sourceBehavior, sourceAdapters, transport, and neo4jDriver; reject ready-made environment/configuration, semantic result, seed list, readiness verdict, retrieval boundary, and test/default credential inputs.

Directly read and attribute all nine approved embedding-profile, Neo4j, and provider-secret keys from raw process/protected-file sources before readiness; reject zero/partial reads, missing secret, unsafe ACL/file state, conflicting dual source, legacy alias, test/default operation, and fallback operation before readiness/provider/vector effects.

Read persistent Element/ArchitectureRelationship/View readiness into one ordered ledger; reject pending, partial, stale, failed, unknown, content mismatch, index mismatch, channel-incomplete, and canonical mismatch evidence with exact state/versions/channels and fullSnapshotFallback:false.

For aligned evidence, make one qualified query embedding call and independently call argo_production_semantic_element_vector, argo_production_semantic_relationship_vector, and argo_production_semantic_view_vector with exact parameterized db.index.vector.queryNodes($indexName, $topK, $vector) Cypher and the unchanged raw provider vector.

Expand top-k from the initial two-record window by following nextOffset until raw windowExhausted for each channel; return every independently qualifying candidate beyond the first window. An all-zero result remains valid only after one readiness read, one embedding, and one exhausted query sequence per channel.

openGaps: Selected viewpoints are the Requirements Realization Viewpoint for SP-03/SP-04 traceability and the Implementation and Migration Viewpoint for default retrieval/readiness and vector-seed/closure decisions. The corrected graph binds each affected view to one primary purpose and the independent intent audit passed after commit 6f0d1e04bb31c5bb23272501d6afdeb573af11f9.

Corrected direct RED is intentional production-behavior absence, not syntax or environment setup: SP-03 fails SP03_DEFAULT_VECTOR_RETRIEVAL_BOUNDARY_MISSING and SP-04 fails SP04_DEFAULT_READINESS_BOUNDARY_MISSING because defaultSemanticRetrieval.js does not exist. Before reaching that boundary, the corrected Harness is syntax-valid and freezes raw source operations, seven credential cases, raw vector windows/exhaustion, exact closure objects/versions, eight readiness cases, and total operation ordering. Existing no-argument and graph-tidy compatibility controls pass.

Current production evidence confirms the defect: systemarchitecture-mcp-server.js createDefaultSemanticRetrievalBoundary hardcodes approved-test-provider, approved-test-model, dimensions 1536, and an empty neo4j-native seed result. This must be removed, not treated as a baseline implementation.

This artifact intentionally supersedes the prior WP-P1 temporary handoff because WP-P1 is accepted and delivered; WP-P1 contracts, implementation, tests, and cleanup boundaries remain frozen and are regression controls only.

Neo4j synchronization evidence remains exactly neo4jUri is required for start. This is environment evidence only and cannot weaken fail-closed readiness, replace deterministic raw production-like acceptance, or be represented as live production proof.

Delegated approval of the first RED design was rejected because it supplied ready-made environment credentials, trusted self-reported top-k evidence, used shape-only closure assertions, and lacked exact readiness ordering/evidence. The first correction was also rejected because approved-source success could read nothing, zero-result success could skip vector calls, index/Cypher/provider-vector correlation was not executable, and View/provenance assertions were incomplete. The third audit found that production assertions existed but the guard lacked explicit malformed counterexamples for missing parent viewpoint, incomplete/version-wrong members, missing/wrong relationship endpoints, and duplicate provenance. This correction freezes exactly thirteen guard-required negative detections covering those cases plus the previously accepted source, zero-result, vector, metadata, and missing-provenance cases. It requires final independent reapproval and then global human approval before stage validation, full runner refresh, stage commit, or downstream emission.
